title: Get Out (Tuco)
blurb: GET OUT. The whole internet credits this scream to Tuco Salamanca, and the whole internet is wrong: the line never appears in Breaking Bad. It actually comes from an unknown streamer on Paradise State Roleplay, a GTA 5 server, erupting at a Lightning McQueen monster truck asking for a spot at a car meet. A 2023 iFunny caption joked that he sounded like Tuco, TikTok repeated the joke until it hardened into fact, and the name stuck for good. The delivery earns the fame either way — one second, zero build-up, total eviction. There is no comeback to it.
origin: A scream by an unknown streamer on the GTA 5 roleplay server Paradise State Roleplay, widely misattributed to Tuco from Breaking Bad.
